messages:
lina: Heads-up: planning MIG-512 (payload normalization) for the 23:00-01:00 UTC change window tomorrow. Goal: normalize events.payload into payload_v2 (jsonb), backfill safely, then atomically flip read path. Steps: 1) ALTER TABLE events ADD COLUMN payload_v2 jsonb; 2) run backfill workers with shard-aware checkpoints; 3) short transaction to set feature flag and swap pointer in config table; 4) monitor for 10m, then drop legacy if healthy. Scheduling now via /deploybot schedule MIG-512 2026-03-24T23:00Z. Please ack and call out concerns/rollback criteria.

deploy-bot: Deploy request MIG-512 created by lina. Scheduled for 1767910000 (2026-03-24T23:00Z). Canary plan: 3% -> 20% -> 100% over 30m. Worker image pinned to workers:v1.7.2 for the window. CI artifact: build-2026-03-24-512.

marc: ack. I'll watch replication lag across read replicas and tail pg_stat_activity. Running lock sensor: ./infra/lock-sensor --mig=MIG-512. Will post 10m cadence.

priya: ack. Backfill parameters: global rate 200 rows/s, per-shard concurrency 3. Checkpoint interval 30s. If backfill error rate >5% over 5m or per-shard failure >1% escalate. Also recommend enabling query_plan_sample for slow backfill runs.

infra-bot: Workers pinned (tag: mig-512-pin). Created alerting rules: alerts for replication_lag_seconds > 180, backfill_error_rate > 0.05, pg_locks_wait_seconds > 20. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/mig-512-normalize.

lina: Adding rollback criteria now so it's explicit: - error rate of core write endpoints increases by >2x baseline for 3 consecutive 1m windows -> abort; - backfill error rate >5% sustained for 5m -> abort; - any exclusive lock on events table > 20s -> abort; - replication lag > 3 minutes for >2m -> abort. Rollback steps: 1) /deploybot abort MIG-512-canary; 2) re-pin workers to previous workers:v1.7.1; 3) set feature flag feature.payload_v2_read = false; 4) pause backfill jobs. Ops on-call to confirm post-abort.

tony: Quick note on pointer swap SQL (do in tiny txn):

```sql
BEGIN;
UPDATE service_config SET value = 'payload_v2' WHERE key = 'events_payload_active';
-- verify small sample counts (SELECT count(*) FROM events WHERE payload_v2 IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1);
COMMIT;
```

marc: Starting canary at 3% now. Health checks passing. Will post at +5m. :rocket:

deploy-bot: Canary reached 3% at 1767824060. Health checks: OK. No elevated error rates.

priya: Backfill worker started. First shard checkpoint at 30s, throughput ~190 rows/s. No errors in first 2m.

marc: Observed a small spike in p95 db write latency at +6m (+18%). Still under Lina/Dave threshold but watchful.

lina: Noted. Keep tight on lockwatch. If it crosses 30% p95 for 2 windows, we abort.

infra-bot: Alert hook: replication_lag_seconds spiked to 210s for replica eu-west-2 at 1767824500. Marc, can you confirm if traffic is affected?

marc: Confirmed lag spike, likely due to a vacuum on replica. Read traffic rerouted away from that replica by LB. Write path unaffected. Monitoring.

priya: Backfill error rate creeping 0.8% on one shard due to JSON parse edgecases. Pausing that shard's workers and rewinding checkpoint to fix parser logic. Patch queued, will roll out to workers pinned image if needed.

lina: Good catch. Pause shard: /backfill pause MIG-512 shard-7. Continue canary on other shards. Keep me posted.

deploy-bot: Canary moved to 20% at 1767824800 after shard-7 paused and other shards healthy. Health checks: OK.

marc: No exclusive locks observed. p95 concisely back to baseline after shard pause.

lina: Final decision: continue to 100% after a 15m steady state. If any rollback criteria hit, follow abort steps and document in release notes. I'll publish release notes summary here after rollout completes. Thanks all for fast responses.

tony: Publishing short troubleshooting snippet to runbook for future: how to resume a paused shard - /backfill resume MIG-512 shard-7 after confirming patch applied.

infra-bot: Final note: added post-migration cleanup job scheduled +24h to drop legacy payload column if no regressions. Job id: cleanup-512-24h.

lina: Closing preflight thread. Will paste release notes and final timeline after completion.
